note: Where the LABELS of every registered dataset come from. The registry reads this file
only for rows whose sidecar `*.meta.json` does not already declare a status; a sidecar
written by the generating script always wins, because it travels with the bytes.
REAL            labels are experimental measurements reported in the cited source
SYNTHETIC       labels were generated (a simulator, not an assay)
COMPUTED        labels are calculated from structure (DFT, docking score), not measured
NOT_APPLICABLE  the file carries no labels at all (structure lists, manifests, tables)
UNRECORDED      nobody wrote it down; never treat this as REAL
Every `evidence` string points at something a reader can check on disk: a column header,
a sidecar field, or a metric JSON that records the provenance of the values. Nothing
here is asserted from memory of the literature alone.

MetalCytoToxDB.csv.evidence: Every row carries DOI + Year + Cell_line + Time; the value columns are named IC50_Dark(M*10^-6) / IC50_Cisplatin(M*10^-6), i.e. the unit is in the header. Sample row: DOI 10.1021/jm301103y, Year 2012, Cell_line MCF-7.

metalcytotox_5metal_multitask.csv.evidence: docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json metalcytotox_raw note names this derivation; the derived files keep the parent's Cell_line / Metal columns, and the parent's values are literature IC50s with a DOI per row.

metalcytotox_5metal_multitask_v2.csv.evidence: Same derivation as metalcytotox_5metal_multitask.csv (docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json metalcytotox_raw note).

metalcytotox_5metal_multitask_v3.csv.evidence: Same derivation as metalcytotox_5metal_multitask.csv (docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json metalcytotox_raw note).

metalcytotox_5metal_multitask_v4.csv.evidence: Same derivation as metalcytotox_5metal_multitask.csv (docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json metalcytotox_raw note).

metalcytotox_5metal_multitask_v5.csv.evidence: Same derivation as metalcytotox_5metal_multitask.csv (docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json metalcytotox_raw note).

metallo_drugs_500_train.csv.evidence: Header is `smiles,source` and nothing else; there is no activity column, so the file has no labels to be real or synthetic.

platinai_4cell.csv.evidence: molmetal/data/platinai_4cell.meta.json records base_log10_ic50_nm=3.95, sigma=0.45 and per-cell offsets; .data/molmetal/platinai_4cell.meta.json says 'SYNTHETIC pIC50 labels ... NOT directly comparable to Rusanov 2025'; docs/DATA_INVENTORY.json marks it DO-NOT-TRAIN. The sidecar wins over this entry; they agree.

lbap_refined_ic50_scaffold.csv.evidence: Header carries `y` (the assay value) and `assay_id`; 266,522 rows. Same schema and row count as the assay / size splits.

lbap_refined_ic50_assay.csv.evidence: Header carries `y` (the assay value) and `assay_id`; 266,522 rows. This is the assay-split variant of lbap_refined_ic50_scaffold.csv.

lbap_refined_ic50_size.csv.evidence: Header carries `y` (the assay value) and `assay_id`; 266,522 rows. This is the size-split variant of lbap_refined_ic50_scaffold.csv.

tmqm_dblock_subset.csv.evidence: Header is csd_code, smiles, metal_center, formal_charge, spin, coord_number, n_atoms, mw, logp, qed_score, sa_score, ... — there is no energy or activity column, so nothing here is a label.

platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl.evidence: Every row carries doi + method + incubationTime + cell_line; .data/molmetal/wf_a37_platinai_biodata/pt/smiles_join_summary.json records 17,735/17,735 rows with SMILES and 15,953 with a numeric value; harvest_summary_2026-10-16.json records the endpoint and per-cell-line counts.
platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl.caveat: The API exposes no unit column. `value_mean` spans 0.00039 to 3.63e7, so the numbers cannot be converted to pIC50 until the unit is established per source DOI. Recorded as an open blocker, not as a usable cohort.

harvest_summary_2026-10-16.json.evidence: The file is the harvest manifest: it counts rows per metal and per cell line (rows_total_all_cells=30185, rows_pt_all_cells=17735) and records the endpoint and wall time. It contains no per-compound measurements; those live in platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl.

platinai_4cell_real_label_pool.csv.evidence: Rows carry value_mean + value_sd + doi + method + incubationTime. The labels are real; the structures are not: 2,052 of 2,053 rows have smiles == '__no_smiles__' because the get-substances join had not run yet. Superseded by platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl (2026-10-19), which has SMILES on every row.
platinai_4cell_real_label_pool.csv.caveat: Do not train on this file: its structure column is a sentinel. Kept only as the provenance record of the earlier pool.

platinai_4cell_real_cohort.csv.source: MB-Finder harvest platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl, collapsed by build_platinai_4cell_real_cohort.py
platinai_4cell_real_cohort.csv.evidence: Every value descends from a row carrying doi + method + incubationTime in platinai_pt_all_cells_with_smiles.jsonl. Unit is uM, stated by the Rusanov 2025 SI figure captions ('log-scaled IC50 values (uM) for individual cell lines'); pIC50 = 6 - log10(IC50_uM). The sibling .meta.json records the source sha256, the filters and the drop counts.
platinai_4cell_real_cohort.csv.caveat: 1,966 compounds, not the 4,078 of the synthetic cohort, and not a reproduction of Rusanov Table S4-S5 (their cohort spans 592 cell lines and is not fully reachable through the public API).

bace.csv.evidence: Header is the MoleculeNet release schema: mol, CID, Class, Model, pIC50, MW, AlogP, HBA, HBD, ... with the official Train/Valid/Test `Model` column.

bbbp.csv.evidence: MoleculeNet BBBP schema and row count (2,050 records) as released.

clintox.csv.gz.evidence: MoleculeNet ClinTox schema and row count (1,484 records) as released.

hiv.csv.evidence: MoleculeNet HIV schema; 41,127 records. Note the file has 82,256 physical lines because quoted fields contain newlines.

nci60_precious_9cell.csv.source: MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal subset restricted to 9 NCI-60-overlapping cell lines
nci60_precious_9cell.csv.evidence: metrics/by_metric/nci60_precious_9cell_auc.json records data_source = 'MetalCytoToxDB.csv (precious-metal subset, NCI-60-overlapping cells)' and framing 'NCI-60 raw release has no SMILES; we use the MetalCytoToxDB subset'. The values therefore inherit MetalCytoToxDB's DOI-backed IC50s.

GI50.csv.evidence: Header carries CONCENTRATION_UNIT, PANEL_NAME, CELL_NAME, COUNT, AVERAGE, STDDEV — the unit is an explicit column, so these are normalisable without inference. 4,851,917 records.

crossdocked100_manifest.csv.evidence: Header is pocket_id, receptor_path, ligand_path, ref_path, metal_atoms, n_atoms, n_residues, source — paths and counts, no activity column.

rusanov_2025_s5_ece.json.evidence: Parsed supplementary table used as an external comparison baseline; not a cohort.

rusanov_2025_s7_pt_wet_lab.json.evidence: Parsed supplementary table used as an external comparison baseline; not a cohort.

rusanov_2025_table_s2_journals.xlsx.evidence: Journal-level summary table from the supplementary workbook.

rusanov_2025_table_s3_resistance.xlsx.evidence: Resistance summary table from the supplementary workbook.

rusanov_2025_table_s4_5ref_complexes.xls.evidence: Descriptive statistics table for the 5 reference complexes.

rusanov_2025_table_s6_214k_predicted.xls.evidence: The filename states these are predictions for 214,373 unlabelled Pt complexes. They are another model's outputs, not measurements — never mix them with measured IC50s.

rusanov_2025_table_s8_roc_auc.xlsx.evidence: Mean ROC-AUC / precision / recall / F1 of the published models; the external numbers our results are compared against.

rusanov_2025_table_s9_427_de_novo.xlsx.evidence: Predicted values for 427 de-novo structures; predictions, not assays.

rusanov_2025_table_s10_signaling.xlsx.evidence: Correlated DEGs in A2780cis cells; no compound activity labels.

rusanov_2025_supplementary_information_v.evidence: PDF document; the parsed tables above are extracted from it.
